title: Points of interest
description: Point-of-interest types with their services and output (spec STR-009..STR-016, STR-096, MGT-068). A Krug market is not a POI category: it is the krugMarket flag on a town or city tile (STR-005, STR-010). A village is a record of category town (STR-009).

category.description: STR-010; villages are town records (STR-009); recruit tiles for STR-096 are town, smallCity, largeCity

settlement.description: STR-009: holds civilian loyalty (cities, towns, villages)

services.description: STR-010, STR-039..STR-042. Krug market services come from the tile flag krugMarket, not from this list

krugMarketAllowed.description: STR-010: a tile with this POI type may carry the krugMarket flag (design: towns and cities)

income.description: STR-014: USD per day to the controller (design draft: gov 500, mechanical 1000, chemical 1000, oil 3000, arms 1500, minerals 1500, town 300, small city 1000, large city 2000, gas station 300)

supplyOutput.description: STR-014: supply points per day to the controller, one point supplies one soldier for one day (design draft: oil, arms, large city 20; mechanical, chemical, small city 10; minerals, gov, town, gas station 5)

military.description: STR-010 / STR-034: fires on hostile helicopters (design: arms plants and governmental institutions)

recruitOutput.description: STR-014: recruits per day (design draft: town 1, small city 2, large city 3)

dailyOutput.description: STR-015 / MGT-068: what a PMC-held plant delivers per day (drafts in MGT-068)

mineralModifier.description: STR-011 (minerals record): output bonus per mineral plant held, design draft 0.10

mineralModifierMax.description: STR-011 (minerals record): cap of the total bonus, design draft 0.30
